request: Every command that writes the plan must give up on the plan's write lock within a bounded wait and say that it timed out, instead of waiting for as long as another process happens to hold it.

defects.description: Own-history fix f3620b437b (2026-10-07): fix(plan): bound the plan lock wait in add-finding and upgrade

trigger.input:
printf %s '' | base64 -d > internal/plan/lock_bound_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run '^(TestPlanWritersGiveUpOnAHeldLock|TestPlanWriterTakesALockReleasedWithinTheBound)$' ./internal/plan >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi

defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
